writeup: TIC 403080487 is a candidate eclipsing binary star with an orbital period of 2.2902 days. Automated analysis of TESS photometry detected a primary eclipse causing 0.81% dimming, with a strong signal-to-noise ratio of 110.4. Pixel-level image analysis confirmed the signal's reality with a difference-imaging peak signal-to-noise of 17.5, though the centroid offset of 2.9 arcsec from the target warrants consideration. No secondary eclipse was detected. The candidate does not appear in six major variable-star catalogs, making it a previously uncatalogued target. The pipeline's machine learning model assigned it a screening score of 0.61, and the candidate passed all data quality checks without flagged concerns.
